$comment: Hero cars, Japanese. THE RULE IS ROCKSTAR'S: the silhouette is exact, the details are not.
Proportion carries recognition — wheelbase, overhangs, roofline, haunches, greenhouse shape —
so those are described precisely. Recognition is then deliberately broken at the lamps, the
mirrors and the bumpers, which is why a car whose real fame is its pop-up headlamps is asked
for flush ones. You should know what it is meant to be and be certain it is not that.
No badge, wordmark or model script ever appears; that is enforced in style.mjs, not here.
dims are real-world metres and exist to be checked against the measured mesh afterwards —
TRELLIS normalises to a 1m cube, so what matters is the RATIO the reconstruction came back with.

silhouette: EXTREMELY low, wide and clean: one unbroken arc from the nose over a small shallow cabin to the tail, with no crease or edge in it
The waist pinches inward between two swollen wheel haunches, so it is widest at the arches
cues: a smooth unbroken nose with NO headlamps visible, concealed under flush panels
